response.overview: Super Bowl XX, played on January 26, 1986, at the Louisiana Superdome in New Orleans, saw the Chicago Bears dominate the New England Patriots 46-10, securing their first-ever Super Bowl title. The victory capped off a remarkable season for the Bears, who finished with a 15-1 record and were considered one of the most dominant teams in NFL history.
response.tagline: Chicago Bears vs. New England Patriots
response.title: Super Bowl XX
